desc: Ideation: enumerate candidate approaches (next-greater binary lifting, monotonic stack + Fenwick, divide & conquer, amortized sliding-window stack, segment-tree monoid).
Implement O(n) amortized deque-of-prefix-max-plateaus sliding window (merge on left insert, subtract on right shrink).
Validate on both provided examples ([6,3,1,2,4,4] k=7 -> 17; [6,3,1,3,6] k=4 -> 12).
Randomized brute-force validation against O(n^2) cost recomputation and edge cases (n=1, all-equal, strictly inc/dec, extreme k).
Confirm performance at n=1e5 (O(n) time, O(n) space, big-int cost up to ~1e14).
